description: This file defines the Authorize controller class within the Opencart admin module, responsible for handling email authorization and reset functionalities. It includes methods to send authorization emails and reset authorization tokens, leveraging models, language files, and views within the system.

classes.name: Authorize
classes.description: Controller class for handling authorization and reset emails in the admin mail module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles sending authorization emails when a session code is set, preparing email data, and creating email tasks.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Handles sending reset authorization emails for a specific user based on provided arguments, preparing email content and creating email tasks.
